exposure: weight of the fetus or newborn
cohort: The study population included all cases of stillbirth and live birth after the 22nd week of gestation to full term, who died within the first week after delivery at Mobini Hospital of Sabzevar, Iran between 2011-2012.
finding: The perinatal mortality rate in the region was not high compared to other regions of the country, although it was higher than that of European countries.
